summary: Iteration 22 — Home UI (Veg toggle + card meta + sort + tagline) and Order-again reorder feature verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 8/8 pass (/app/backend/tests/test_home_veg_reorder.py). Verified: GET /api/restaurants returns has_veg (bool), distance (km, nearest-first then by area with None last), and category on every row; GET /api/drops returns vendor_category + food_type + persistent distance when lat/lon supplied; GET /api/featured-deals returns vendor_category (and food_type/distance) per row; GET /api/browse-deals returns category per row. GET /api/orders/{id}/reorder (auth) returns the full checkout params payload {itemId,name,price,originalPrice,vendorName,maxQty,imageUrl,orderType,isOpen,openStatusText,todayShifts}, returns 404 for someone else's order and 400 'no longer available' when the surplus item is toggled unavailable. Frontend E2E (Expo web, 390x844, real customer login → /home → /orders → /checkout): 'Veg' toggle exists top-right (testID veg-only-toggle); tagline reads exactly 'Upto 70% off. Grab it before it’s gone'; Surplus/Featured/Restaurant cards render 'Bakery · 0.8 km' meta; Nearby Restaurants sorted nearest-first (E2E Bakery 0.8 km appears above 'Draft Test Kitchen' fallback); long name 'Extra Long Chicken Tikka Burger Signature Special XL' truncates with ellipsis inside the card and the Verified badge stays on-screen. Toggling Veg ON hid the non-veg surplus card (3→2 surplus cards, both remaining are veg) and toggling OFF restored 3. Orders screen shows a single 'Order again' button (testID reorder-{order_id}) on the picked_up order and NO reorder on the reserved order (which still shows Support + Cancel); tapping Order again navigates to /checkout?itemId=…&name=Fresh%20Veg%20Croissant%20Delight&price=45&originalPrice=100&vendorName=E2E%20Bakery&maxQty=8&orderType=surplus&isOpen=1&openStatusText=Open%20%C2%B7%20closes%2011%3A59%20PM&todayShifts=[…] — the Checkout screen renders the pre-filled item name/vendor, PICKUP SLOT chip and an active Pay ₹49.50 button. Razorpay was NOT invoked (test stops at pre-filled checkout, per instructions). No React Native red screens or deprecated Expo packages observed on the tested screens.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_drops L671-677 duplicates the distance computation via a temporary _dist field for sort even though every drop now has a persistent `distance` (L660-665). The sort key can just read d['distance'] directly and remove the pop step — minor cleanup, not a bug.

server.py reorder L1507 uses datetime.now(IST).weekday() to pick 'today's shifts'. Consistent with rest of _open_status; note IST fixed midnight boundary — reorder immediately after IST midnight will return the new day's shifts (correct).

home.tsx renderRestaurant L235 renders `item.category` but if a vendor has no category the row shows an empty line; consider hiding when empty. Same applies to featured/surplus card meta rows (already guarded by `item.vendor_category ?` — good).

orders.tsx L172 pickup_code is rendered as plain digits — good, but note that the reorder button ships on 'expired' or 'refunded' statuses too via `!isReserved`; STATUS_CONFIG needs an entry for 'expired' otherwise the pill falls back to reserved's label ('Ready for Pickup'). Check STATUS_CONFIG covers all expected statuses.
home.tsx L268 vegRestaurants filter uses `r.has_veg` which is true only if the vendor has AT LEAST ONE in-stock item with food_type != non_veg — this matches the user's chosen semantics.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows verified (veg toggle on/off, tagline text, km+category on cards, nearest-first sort, long-name truncation with visible Verified badge, order-again on past order, no reorder on reserved order, checkout pre-filled after tap)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression: `export EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://perfectly-good-build.preview.emergentagent.com && python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_home_veg_reorder.py -v`. The module-scoped fixture creates an ACTIVE vendor (open 00:01-23:59 all week), forces vendor.location coords via pymongo (geocode returns zeros for synthetic addresses), and seeds orders directly into Mongo since /orders/create returns a razorpay_order_id (order is only finalised post-payment) — you cannot exercise the reorder endpoint via the public order-creation path without completing a real Razorpay payment. For the frontend, log in as any customer, then visit /home to see the Veg toggle top-right and Nearby restaurants sorted nearest-first when the browser grants geolocation; if geolocation is denied, distance will be null and the card meta will omit 'X km' (which is expected behaviour — user location comes from navigator.geolocation, not a query param). The reorder button is rendered by orders.tsx when `item.status !== 'reserved'` — that covers picked_up/cancelled/refunded/expired.
